exposure: Delivery route (vaginal, classic cesarean, low transverse cesarean, low vertical cesarean)
outcome: Serious maternal complications (hemorrhage, infection, ICU admission, death)
cohort: 2659 women delivering nonanomalous singletons between 23-33 weeks gestation from 25 US hospitals.
finding: The risk of serious maternal complications after early preterm delivery was substantial, particularly in women who underwent cesarean delivery, with higher risks observed at earlier gestational ages.
